title: Missing Number
summary: An array holds every number from 0 to n but one, in any order; find the one that is missing.
followUps: Can you find it in O(n) time with only a constant amount of extra memory, without changing nums?
If nums were sorted, how fast could you find the missing number?
What if the array held n numbers from 0 to n + 1, so that two were missing: how would you find both?
